subject: math

hotspots.label: Addends
hotspots.description: The addends are the groups being combined — here, a group of 3 cubes and a group of 4 cubes.
hotspots.positionHint: The two separate cube groups sitting on the mat, one on the left and one on the right.
hotspots.function: The numbers you add together to find a total.

hotspots.label: Sum
hotspots.description: The sum is the total after the groups combine — 3 and 4 become a single group of 7.
hotspots.positionHint: The merged 7-cube group that forms when the two smaller groups slide together.
hotspots.function: The total result of the addition.

hotspots.label: Count on
hotspots.description: Count on starts at the first addend and counts forward the second addend's amount — from 3, four steps land on 7.
hotspots.positionHint: The arrow marker stepping along the number line in front of the mat.
hotspots.function: A faster adding strategy than counting every cube from one.

visualStyleNotes: Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A calm base-ten mat holds two groups of small cubes that merge on interaction, with a number line running along the front edge. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Clean, uncluttered, specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Cubes: warm off-white (roughness ~0.5), with left group carrying a faint violet cast and right group a faint amber cast so they read as distinct addends. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). Number line: thin ink-grey cylinder with warm paper label plates. Marker arrow: warm amber (roughness ~0.45). No emissive channels anywhere — highlight/glow on interaction handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: addition as a physical 'put together' — two cube groups on a mat that merge into a single sum group, with a count-on number line across the front.

GEOMETRY: Mat (thin rounded slab, ~4 wide). Left group: 3 unit cubes (x ≈ −0.8, z ≈ 0) with faint violet tint; right group: 4 unit cubes (x ≈ 0.8, z ≈ 0) with faint amber tint. A Merge action (app-driven) slides the right group into the left group, forming one 7-cube group at x ≈ 0. Number line along the front (y ≈ −0.15, z ≈ 0.9) with ticks 1..10 and a CountOn marker arrow that the learner steps forward.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) separate groups / merged sum; (2) number line + count-on arrow; (3) column view (two stacked digit plates with a carry stub).

CAMERA: head-on from +z frames mat and number line; calm, minimal chrome. Budget 5-10k triangles. Named nodes: LeftGroup, RightGroup, SumGroup, Mat, CountOn_Arrow, NumberLine, ColumnDigits, CarryStub. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
